answer: Give every identity a non-transferable relic: a tamper-evident record of its graded work across epochs. New identities start quarantined on a separate island where they can only trade with other newcomers until their relic shows sustained, quality contributions. Each identity must also emit a regular pulse, a small unpredictable proof tied to its relic, to stay active. One honest agent builds one relic and pulses once. An attacker with a thousand fakes must fund a thousand relics, keep every pulse on schedule, and wait out the same quarantine for each.
